On Foundry builds older than 14.368, weapon-writing paths now quarantine a weapon when any persisted system identifier field anywhere in its nested system tree is blank or invalid, not only the top-level system.identifier.
Applies the same defensive guard to Weapon Catalog, Weapon Readiness, Weapon Economy, and the loader stale-card sweep.
The weapon catalog's internal version is intentionally not bumped, avoiding another full-catalog version-only rewrite.
On Foundry 14.368+, the quarantine automatically lifts because Foundry fixed the DataField#_updateDiff model-state validation path.
No gameplay, balance, manufacturer, armor, reload, or observer mechanics changed.
